chapters.title: Linking inbound e-documents to purchase invoices

features.name: PEPPOL moved to first-party app
features.description: PEPPOL format has been redesigned and moved from the base app to a new first-party app, providing better control, scalability, and easier customizations.
caveats: Electronic document formats from base app will be phased out

features.name: Link inbound e-documents to purchase invoices
features.description: Ability to link inbound e-documents to already-created purchase invoices, particularly useful for intercompany scenarios where a purchase invoice may be created by intercompany process but the same invoice arrives through the e-document connector.
caveats: Currently only allowed for intercompany vendors
Vendor amounts must match the received invoice total

features.name: Default e-document type on vendor templates
features.description: Ability to set default e-document type on vendor templates, allowing configuration of whether the default option is purchase invoice or purchase order.

features.name: Service participant linked to company information
features.description: Service participant can now be linked to company information in addition to customer vendors, enabling better compliance with local regulations.

features.name: Payment with e-documents
features.description: Payment functionality enabled with e-documents, primarily required in French localization but enabled in the framework for other localizations.

features.name: Verify tool in Spain
features.description: E-documents verification tool enabled for Spain in public preview. The preview status is because enforcement is not yet mandatory, allowing users to test and provide feedback.
features.status_evidence_quote: this is a public preview but this is completed

features.name: E-invoicing in Denmark with carbon footprint
features.description: E-invoicing in Denmark using OIOUBL format now integrated with carbon footprint capability, allowing financial and carbon footprint details to be sent together with automatic population of carbon footprint information in purchase invoices.

features.name: French electronic invoicing
features.description: Work in progress on French electronic invoicing functionality. Details are available in the release plan.

features.name: PEPPOL 3.0 format enum and extensibility
features.description: PEPPOL 3.0 format exposed with 10 interfaces divided into different parts of the format, allowing developers to extend specific parts without changing the entire format.

features.name: PEPPOL validation interface
features.description: PEPPOL validation interface available for custom validation logic, allowing developers to add custom fields validation before creating PEPPOL format.

features.name: PEPPOL 3.0 setup page
features.description: New PEPPOL 3.0 setup page in Business Central allowing users to select specific enum values and configure PEPPOL implementation.

features.name: Electronic document formats phasing out
features.description: Electronic document formats functionality is being phased out from the base app as e-documents capabilities now provide the same functionality.
